narrative:
Paulding County has 12,226 registered voters, with 53.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 11.9%, a pronounced Republican lean of 22.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.2% of registrants.
